strategies.name: support_to_resistance_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: After letting the first 5 to 15 minutes pass on the 5-minute chart to identify support, enter a scalp when price pulls back into a recognized support area such as the 13 EMA, 200 EMA, prior bounce area, or demand zone and bounces there.
strategies.exit_summary: Take profit quickly into the next resistance area rather than holding; the teaching is to get in at support and sell at resistance without overstaying the trade.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for early session support to establish, then buy the touch/bounce at the 13 EMA support area
variants.target_note: exit on the quick push into nearby resistance / after the small multi-candle move
variants.transcript_quote: this 13 EMA operated as a initial support... the stock came down and it hit right there that's our entry for a scalp

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: re-enter when price comes back down to the same support level and holds again
variants.target_note: take the next quick move up and exit
variants.transcript_quote: it came back down again boom same level you enter here and then boom you got this move now we have formed this is your exit

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: once the 13 EMA no longer holds, use the deeper 200 EMA support bounce as the entry area
variants.target_note: ride from support to resistance and exit there
variants.transcript_quote: you get in here as support and you ride it to resistance and you exit okay another quick Scout this one off a deeper support sitting at the 200 EMA

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: identify price areas where the stock repeatedly bottoms and bounces; buy when it returns to that support/demand zone
variants.target_note: sell right at resistance for a short scalp move
variants.transcript_quote: take a quick small trade that you see at support sell right at resistance

strategies.name: support_breakdown_short_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: When the identified support level, specifically the 200 EMA in the example, is finally lost, enter in the direction of the breakdown to catch the larger move lower.
strategies.exit_summary: Exit into the sharp downside expansion soon after the breakdown; the example points to covering after the large move down rather than holding indefinitely.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: enter once price loses the 200 EMA support
variants.target_note: cover after the big downward scalp move
variants.transcript_quote: once we lost the support of the 200 look at this move boom boom boom you want to exit right there okay that's your big scout you would have entered

result.enumeration_note: Two distinct strategies are taught: a long support-bounce scalp sold into resistance, and the opposing breakdown short after support fails; repeated EMA/support examples are variants of the same support-to-resistance skeleton.
